created: Done, we created the account. The invitation is pending delivery.
updated: Done, we saved the account changes.
activation_code_regenerated: Done, we issued a new activation code. Hand it over: you will only see it now.
last_admin: You cannot deactivate your own account: the company would be left with nobody to assign the work.
responsible_has_no_team: That manager does not have a delegate team yet. Create the team first and invite the person again.
responsibles_group_invalid: The “Responsables” group of your company is not led by an administrator, so it cannot hold managers. Pick another managers group.
not_activated: This person has not activated their account yet. Meanwhile you can issue a new code.
already_active: This account is already activated: it does not need a new code.
limit_reached: Your company has reached the number of users it contracted. Deactivate an account or ask to raise the limit.
